misprints.note: Article printed without an accent, and with a full stop after φρόνημα.
The genitive ending is printed without a breathing, which is normal for an ending. Kept as printed and listed for information only.
The iota subscript is missing from the dative προθυμία, though πάσῃ has one.
Comma printed after the termination number where a full stop is expected.
Line break printed with a full stop instead of a hyphen. Kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The accent on καλη looks grave in the scan, so it is kept as grave.
The grave on the second τὸ is faint.
